title: FPS Flood: Cobblemon
description: Adds Cobblemon to FPS Flood by PixelForge Collective.
body:
# FPS Flood: Cobblemon – by Pixelforge Collective

Looking for an optimized Cobblemon experience? FPS Flood: Cobblemon combines the world of Cobblemon with the performance and quality-of-life improvements that FPS Flood is known for.

FPS Flood: Cobblemon is a performance-focused Minecraft modpack built to improve FPS, responsiveness, and overall gameplay smoothness while delivering a polished Cobblemon adventure.

The modpack includes a carefully tested collection of optimization mods, interface improvements, visual enhancements, and quality-of-life features designed to provide a smoother experience while exploring, battling, and collecting Pokémon in Minecraft.

## Features

* Cobblemon integrated into a lightweight performance-focused experience
* Major FPS and performance improvements
* Better optimization for multiplayer servers
* Enhanced UI and menu improvements
* Additional graphics and gameplay settings
* Quality-of-life upgrades
* Carefully tested and optimized mod selection
* Lightweight and smooth gameplay experience

FPS Flood: Cobblemon keeps the familiar Minecraft experience while expanding it with Cobblemon and modern performance-focused enhancements.

## Notes

* Performance may vary depending on your hardware and graphics settings.
* Recommended: 4GB of allocated RAM.
* This modpack was tested on older hardware (including DDR3L RAM).
* For best performance, use a screen resolution appropriate for your GPU.
